glsa.title: FreeType: Multiple Vulnerabilities
glsa.synopsis: Multiple vulnerabilities have been found in FreeType, the worst of which could result in arbitrary code execution.

background.p: FreeType is a software font engine that is designed to be small, efficient, highly customizable, and portable while capable of producing high-quality output (glyph images).

description.p: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in FreeType. Please review the CVE identifiers referenced below for details.

impact.p: Please review the referenced CVE identifiers for details.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.

resolution.p: All FreeType users should upgrade to the latest version:
